<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace __MODULE__\Presentation\Api\Provider\__AREA__;

use ApiPlatform\Metadata\Operation;
use ApiPlatform\State\ProviderInterface;
use Auth\Infrastructure\Security\User\SecurityUser;
use __MODULE__\Application\UseCase\Query\__AREA__\__USE_CASE__\{__QUERY_CLASS__, __RESULT_CLASS__};
use __MODULE__\Presentation\Api\Dto\Output\__AREA__\__OUTPUT_CLASS__;
use InvalidArgumentException;
use Shared\Application\Exception\MessengerRuntimeException;
use Shared\Application\Port\Inbound\QueryBusPort;
use Symfony\Bundle\SecurityBundle\Security;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\{AccessDeniedHttpException, BadRequestHttpException};

use function is_string;

/**
 * Provider __PROVIDER_CLASS__.
 *
 * Keep filtering, permission checks, and query dispatch here. Leave business decisions to the query handler.
 *
 * @category Provider
 *
 * @version 1.0.0
 *
 * @author __AUTHOR__
 *
 * @implements ProviderInterface<__OUTPUT_CLASS__>
 */
final readonly class __PROVIDER_CLASS__ implements ProviderInterface
{
  // #region Constructor
  public function __construct(
    private QueryBusPort $queryBus,
    private __AUTHORIZATION_PORT__ $authorization,
    private Security $security,
  ) {
  }
  // #endregion

  // #region Methods
  /**
   * Method provide.
   *
   * Example responsibility split:
   * - validate authenticated user and URI variables here
   * - build the query contract for the application layer
   * - map the returned result to the output DTO or paginator
   *
    * @since 1.0.0
    *
    * @param Operation $operation the API operation metadata
   * @param array<string, mixed> $uriVariables URI variables extracted from the request
   * @param array<string, mixed> $context provider context values
   */
  public function provide(Operation $operation, array $uriVariables = [], array $context = []): object
  {
    $user = $this->security->getUser();
    if (!$user instanceof SecurityUser) {
      throw new AccessDeniedHttpException('Authentication required.');
    }

    $scopeId = $uriVariables['__SCOPE_ID__'] ?? null;
    if (!is_string($scopeId) || '' === $scopeId) {
      throw new BadRequestHttpException('__SCOPE_ID__ URI parameter is required.');
    }

    if (!$this->authorization->__AUTHORIZATION_METHOD__($user->getId(), $scopeId, '__PERMISSION__')) {
      throw new AccessDeniedHttpException('Missing __PERMISSION__ permission.');
    }

    try {
      /** @var __RESULT_CLASS__ $result */
      $result = $this->queryBus->ask(new __QUERY_CLASS__(
        __SCOPE_ID__: $scopeId,
        __QUERY_ARGUMENTS__
      ));
    } catch (InvalidArgumentException $exception) {
      throw new BadRequestHttpException($exception->getMessage(), $exception);
    } catch (MessengerRuntimeException $exception) {
      throw $exception;
    }

    return $this->mapResult($result);
  }

  /**
   * Method mapResult.
   *
   * Keep output mapping explicit so filters and serialization remain easy to reason about.
   *
   * @since 1.0.0
   */
  private function mapResult(__RESULT_CLASS__ $result): __OUTPUT_CLASS__
  {
    $output = new __OUTPUT_CLASS__();
    __OUTPUT_ASSIGNMENTS__

    return $output;
  }
  // #endregion
}
